extension.name: SMTP Router (IPIK)
extension.description: Route CiviCRM outbound emails to the correct SMTP server based on the From address. Required for Infomaniak hosting where each sender must authenticate individually. Developed with Claude.ai.
extension.author: Frédéric Hiltbrand — IPIK
extension.comments: Tested on CiviCRM 6.15.4 / WordPress / Infomaniak shared hosting. Uses PEAR Mail (not PHPMailer) for SMTP delivery. Developed with Claude.ai (Anthropic).
